report_name: ConnectWise Supply Chain Attack Disrupts Cloud Services, M365

attack_patterns.name: Supply Chain Compromise
attack_patterns.description: Threat actors conducted a supply chain attack by compromising an application credential from IT software provider ConnectWise to gain access to the Microsoft 365 environments of its downstream MSP partners and their customers.

attack_patterns.name: Steal Application Access Token
attack_patterns.description: The attack stemmed from the compromise of an application credential (a client assertion) for ConnectWise's multitenant OAuth application, which was then used to gain unauthorized access.

attack_patterns.name: Access Token Manipulation
attack_patterns.description: Attackers used a compromised application credential to generate a client assertion, manipulating the OAuth 2.0 client credentials flow to authenticate as the trusted ConnectWise application.

attack_patterns.name: Valid Accounts: Cloud Accounts
attack_patterns.description: The threat actor authenticated using the compromised application-level service principal, bypassing user-based MFA and inheriting the highly privileged permissions granted to the ConnectWise application by customers.

attack_patterns.name: Trusted Relationship
attack_patterns.description: The attack leveraged the trusted relationship between Managed Service Providers (MSPs), their customers, and the ConnectWise platform to pivot into hundreds of M365 environments.

tools.name: ConnectWise Cloud Backup
tools.description: The multitenant OAuth application for ConnectWise Cloud Backup (formerly SkyKick) was compromised. Its application credential was stolen and abused by threat actors to access customer M365 tenants.

campaigns.name: ConnectWise OAuth Credential Compromise Campaign
campaigns.description: A supply chain attack campaign where threat actors compromised a ConnectWise OAuth application credential to gain widespread access to the M365 tenants of MSPs and their customers.

identities.name: ConnectWise
identities.description: IT management software provider whose cloud services and multitenant OAuth application were compromised in a supply chain attack.

identities.name: Managed Service Provider (MSP) partners
identities.description: Downstream partners of ConnectWise whose Microsoft 365 tenants, and those of their customers, were accessed by threat actors using the compromised application credential.

infrastructure.name: Attacker Sign-in Infrastructure
infrastructure.description: IP address observed by Huntress conducting suspicious sign-in activity against at least 162 Microsoft 365 tenants between October 15 and 16, 2026.

indicators.name: Anomalous M365 Application Role Assignment

level: medium

  product: m365
  service: audit.azuread

    Operation: 'Add app role assignment to service principal'

indicators.description: Detects anomalous activity by service principals, such as adding application role assignments. This was a recommended hunting query following the ConnectWise incident to find potential abuse of the compromised application's permissions.
